nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Hotel Frontend Buttons (6 files, 27 alerts + 1 prompt)
nodes.rationale: All 27 alert stubs and 1 prompt in BookingFlow/RoomTariff/CollectPayment/EditBooking/RoomMaintenance/AllBooking were replaced with real HTTP calls plus inline rose/emerald error banners, because the alert pattern swallowed server state and hid failure from success. Backend-behaviour gap found: POST /hotel/refund/:id inserts a payments row with payment_type='refund' but never updates bookings.advance_amount or balance_amount (refundBooking lacks the rollup arithmetic that updateAdvance performs), so refunds record in the ledger while the booking's displayed remaining amount is unchanged - client-side validation was added to prevent over-refund, but the balance figure is a backend fix. Routing layer decision pending: AllBooking.jsx, RoomTariff.jsx and CollectPayment.jsx are not imported by anything because Hotel.jsx covers their paths with the single BookingFlow component, while EditBooking.jsx is live via the Stayover.jsx modal and RoomMaintenance.jsx is live at /hotel/room-maintenance.

nodes.label: Maa-Baglamkhi-Resort-frontend (Vite React app)
nodes.rationale: React frontend served by Vite dev server on 127.0.0.1:5173, which proxies /api to the live backend on 127.0.0.1:5002 (MySQL). All verification in the HAG-54/HAG-42/HAG-59 reports ran over this proxy path, the same path the browser takes; the dev server serves each changed file as a byte-identical transformed module, so source reading plus live payloads substitutes for browser-driven rendering checks.

nodes.label: src/components/Dashboard/Stayover.jsx (embeds EditBooking)
nodes.rationale: The /stayover screen embeds EditBooking.jsx as a modal, making it the only hotel-booking screen of the six-file slice that is live and reachable; rendering was verified in the browser. It also imports the broken ../utils/localDate, so the module 500s under Vite until the import-path defect is fixed in src/.
